/*=========================================================================================================================
** Procedure Desc	:  매일 캐릭터의 레벨 데이타와 클랜 데이타를 운영 DB 에 Insert 한다.
** Argument Desc	:   
** Return Type		:  
** Modify Desc
** Date			: 2009-09-23
** Programmer		: Na Seung Eun
** Changes		: 
**=========================================================================================================================*/
CREATE    PROC  [dbo].[OP_CharData]
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Seridx TINYINT
	SET @Seridx=1

	INSERT INTO AsdaStoryOp.dbo.CharDataBefore
	SELECT *
	FROM AsdaStoryOp.dbo.CharData

	TRUNCATE TABLE AsdaStoryOp.dbo.CharData

	INSERT INTO AsdaStoryOp.dbo.CharData(Edate,Seridx,Userindex,Charidx,Uid,Charname,Gender,Lvl,Expe,Job,Clanname,Grade)
	SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE()-1, 20),@seridx,i.Userindex,i.Charidx,Uid,i.Charname,Gender,Lvl,Expe,Job,ISNULL(Cname,'-'),ISNULL(Grade,0)
	FROM dbo.Charinfo i WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ClanMember m WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.userindex=m.userindex AND i.charidx = m.charidx
	LEFT OUTER JOIN AsdaStoryOp.dbo.Us_member u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.userindex=i.userindex
	WHERE i.Userindex>5000 AND us_block=0
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE PROC [dbo].[OP_DelChar]  @Userindex INT, @Charidx TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @seridx TINYINT,@Flag TINYINT,@uid VARCHAR(61),@Count TINYINT,@Charname VARCHAR(20),@DATE DATETIME,@Grade TINYINT,@Clanidx SMALLINT 
	SET @DATE = GETDATE()
	SET @Flag = 1
	SET @seridx=0

	SELECT @uid=Uid,@Charname=Charname FROM dbo.Charinfo WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
	IF @Charname IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @FLAG = 0
		--SELECT @Flag AS Flag 
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
	 	SELECT @Clanidx=Clanidx,@Grade=Grade FROM dbo.ClanMember WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx 
	
		IF @Grade = 1
		BEGIN		
			SET @FLAG = 2
			--SELECT @Flag AS Flag 
			DELETE FROM dbo.ClanData WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
			DELETE FROM dbo.ClanMember WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
		END
		
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Grade=0
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM dbo.ClanMember WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
				UPDATE dbo.ClanData SET JoinCnt=Joincnt-1 WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
			END

			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharAppr (Edate,Userindex, Charidx,HairStyle, HairColor, FaceType )
			SELECT @DATE,Userindex,Charidx,HairStyle,HairColor,FaceType FROM CharAppr  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharChat 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM CharChat  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharEpisode 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM CharEpisode  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_Charinfo 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.Charinfo  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharPos 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.CharPos  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharQuest
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.CharQuest  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharSkill 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.CharSkill  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharSlot 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.CharSlot  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_VillagePos
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.VillagePos  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_SoulJewel
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.SoulJewel  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex1 = @Userindex  AND Charidx1 =  @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharRefine (Edate,Userindex, Charidx, pLvl, pExp, aLvl, aExp, mLvl, mExp)
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.CharRefine  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_Item 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.Item  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)  WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND  Charidx = @Charidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_ExItem 
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.ExItem  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)  WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND  Charidx = @Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.CharAppr WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharCamp WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.CharChat WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.CharConstellation WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.CharEpisode WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharFame WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.CharFameBank WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.CharFameProgress WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx =  @Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.Charinfo WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharPos WHERE Userindex=@Userindex  AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharinPos WHERE Userindex=@Userindex  AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharQuest WHERE Userindex=@Userindex  AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharSkill WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharSlot WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharStatus WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.EpisodeTime  WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.VillagePos WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx= @Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.SoulGuardian WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx= @Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.SoulJewel WHERE Userindex1=@Userindex AND Charidx1= @Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.SoulJewel WHERE Userindex2=@Userindex AND Charidx2= @Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.VillagePos WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
			
			DELETE FROM dbo.SkillCooltime WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.ItemCooltime WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharSkillItem WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharRefine WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.Item WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

			DELETE FROM dbo.ExItem WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.SellItemAlarm WHERE Buserindex=@Userindex AND Bcharidx=@Charidx
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.SellItemAlarm WHERE Suserindex=@Userindex AND Scharidx=@Charidx

			--###################유저 신제련 테이블 삭제 2010-06-10############		
			INSERT INTO dbo.CRT_Del_CharCraftInfo
			SELECT @DATE,*
			FROM dbo.CRT_CharCraftInfo WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
			DELETE FROM dbo.CRT_CharCraftInfo WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx			

			-- 반복퀘정보
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CRT_MainLimitationQuest
			SELECT @DATE,*
			FROM dbo.CRT_MainLimitationQuest WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
			DELETE FROM dbo.CRT_MainLimitationQuest WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CRT_LimitationQuest
			SELECT @DATE,* 
			FROM dbo.CRT_LimitationQuest WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
			DELETE FROM dbo.CRT_LimitationQuest 	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

			-- 낚시 관련 로그 추가 및 데이터 삭제
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharFish
			SELECT @DATE, Userindex, Charidx, FishingSkill 
			FROM dbo.CharFish WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)  WHERE Userindex=@Userindex  AND  Charidx=@Charidx
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharFish WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharFishBookInfo
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.CharFishBookInfo WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)  WHERE Userindex=@Userindex  AND  Charidx=@Charidx
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharFishBookInfo WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

			-- Tutorial Log Add & Delete
			INSERT INTO dbo.Del_CharTutorial
			SELECT @DATE, * FROM dbo.CharTutorial WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)  WHERE Userindex = @Userindex  AND  Charidx = @Charidx
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharTutorial WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

		SELECT @Count = COUNT(Userindex) FROM dbo.Charinfo WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex
		IF @Count = 0
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharOption WHERE Userindex = @Userindex

			INSERT INTO  dbo.Del_SoulMate
			SELECT @DATE,* FROM dbo.SoulMate WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex OR Ouserindex=@Userindex

			DELETE FROM dbo.SoulMate WHERE Userindex=@Userindex OR Ouserindex=@Userindex
		END


	
			DELETE FROM dbo.CharSpecial WHERE Userindex = @Userindex
	
			DELETE FROM dbo.SoulMate WHERE Userindex=@Userindex OR Ouserindex=@Userindex

			INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.CharEventDel (Edate, Userindex, Charidx, Charname)
			VALUES ( @DATE, @Userindex, @Charidx, @Charname)

			IF @Userindex>5000
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM AsdaStoryOp.dbo.CharacterStat
				WHERE Userindex=@userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Seridx=@Seridx
			END

		END
	END
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGrantExectoStoredProcs]
 @user sysname,
 @PROC_SEARCH varchar(10) = '' -- 특정프로시져 LIKE 검색조건자

AS 
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Object Name: spGrantExectoAllStoredProcs
-- Author: Edgewood Solutions
-- Development Date: 03.19.2007
-- Called By: TBD
-- Description: Issue GRANT EXEC statement for all stored procedures 
-- based on the user name that is passed in to this stored procedure
-- Project: SQL Server Security
-- Database: User defined databases 
-- Business Process: SQL Server Security
-- 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Num | CRF ID | Date Modified | Developer | Description
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 001 | N\A      | 03.15.2007    | Edgewood | Original code for the GRANT 
-- 002 Bluejini | Modify code for the GRANT ADD @PROC_SEARCH 
-- EXEC process
-- 
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON
 
-- 1 - 변수선언
DECLARE @CMD1 varchar(8000)
DECLARE @MAXOID int
DECLARE @OwnerName varchar(128)
DECLARE @ObjectName varchar(128)
 
-- 2 - 임시테이블생성
CREATE TABLE #StoredProcedures
(OID int IDENTITY (1,1),
StoredProcOwner varchar(128) NOT NULL,
StoredProcName varchar(128) NOT NULL)
 
-- 3 - 임시테이블에프로시져리스트추가
INSERT INTO #StoredProcedures (StoredProcOwner, StoredProcName)
SELECT ROUTINE_SCHEMA, ROUTINE_NAME
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES 
WHERE ROUTINE_NAME NOT LIKE 'dt_%'
AND ROUTINE_TYPE = 'PROCEDURE' AND ROUTINE_NAME like @PROC_SEARCH
 
-- 4 - 임시테이블MAX 값
SELECT @MAXOID = MAX(OID) FROM #StoredProcedures
 
-- 5 - 루프
WHILE @MAXOID > 0
BEGIN 
 
-- 6 - 변수정의
SELECT @OwnerName = StoredProcOwner,
@ObjectName = StoredProcName
FROM #StoredProcedures
WHERE OID = @MAXOID
 
-- 7 - Build the string
SELECT @CMD1 = 'GRANT EXEC ON ' + '[' + @OwnerName + ']' + '.' + '[' + @ObjectName + ']' + ' TO ' + @user
 
-- 8 - Execute the string
 
EXEC(@CMD1)
 
-- 9 - Decrement @MAXOID
SET @MAXOID = @MAXOID - 1
END
 
-- 10 - 임시테이블삭제
DROP TABLE #StoredProcedures
 
SET NOCOUNT OFF

** Argument설명	:  @Seridx 서버인덱스, @Userindex 유저인덱스, @Charidx 캐릭터 인덱스
** Return Type		:

** Date			:  2006-03-20
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  us_member 테이블의 us_cash 필드 변화
**                        WareCount,CwareCount tinyint -> smallint 로 변환

CREATE         PROC [dbo].[UPCharInfo]  @Seridx TINYINT, @Userindex INT, @Charidx TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON	
	DECLARE @Charname VARCHAR(20),@Clan TINYINT,@Gender TINYINT,@Job TINYINT,@Subjob TINYINT,@lvl TINYINT,@Expe BIGINT,@Class TINYINT, 
	@SkillPoint SMALLINT,@Maxweight SMALLINT,@Weight SMALLINT,@Mac INT,@Charisma INT,@PCharisma TINYINT,@Charcount TINYINT,@wareCount SMALLINT,
	@CWareCount SMALLINT,@PetCount TINYINT,@ActPoint INT,@DonationPoint INT,@Speed SMALLINT,@Fameidx TINYINT,@JobCount TINYINT,
	@Soultype TINYINT,@we SMALLINT,@Co SMALLINT,@Reset TINYINT,@Eco TINYINT

	SELECT @Co=COUNT(*)
	FROM  Joy1.dbo.Item WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=5
	
	SELECT @We=SUM(Weight)
	FROM dbo.Item WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx = @Charidx AND Plate <> 5 

	SELECT @ECo=COUNT(*)
	FROM dbo.Item WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate > 5
	
	IF @ECo > 0
	BEGIN		
		DECLARE @fCnt INT
		SET @fCnt = 1
		WHILE @fCnt <= @ECo
		BEGIN
			EXEC dbo.UpItemLockCancel  @Userindex,@Charidx 
			SET @fCnt = @fCnt + 1
		END
	END


	UPDATE dbo.Charinfo
	SET Weight=@We,CWareCount=@Co
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

	SELECT @Charname=Charname,@Gender=Gender,@lvl=Lvl,@Expe=Expe,@JobCount=JobCount,@Class=Class,@Job=Job,@Subjob=Subjob,@SkillPoint=SkillPoint, 
	@Maxweight=Maxweight, @Weight=Weight,@ActPoint=ActPoint,@DonationPoint=DonationPoint,
	@wareCount=WareCount,@CWareCount =CWareCount ,@PetCount=PetCount	
	FROM Charinfo  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx = @Charidx

	SET @Mac=0
	SET @Soultype=0
	SET @Clan = 0
	SET @Reset=0
	SET @Speed=0
	SET @Fameidx = 0
	SET @CharCount = 3
	SET @PCharisma = 0
	SET @Charisma = 0
	
	SELECT @Charname AS Charname, @Charidx AS Charidx, @Seridx AS Seridx, @Clan AS Clan, @Gender AS Gender, @Job AS Job, @Subjob AS Subjob, 
	@Lvl AS Lvl, @Expe AS Expe, @Skillpoint AS Skillpoint, @Class AS Class, @Speed AS Speed, @MaxWeight AS MaxWeight, @Weight AS Weight, @Mac AS Mac, 
	@Charisma AS Charisma, @PCharisma AS PCharisma, @Charcount AS Charcount, @WareCount AS WareCount, @CWareCount  AS CWareCount, 
	@Fameidx AS Fameidx, @JobCount AS JobCount, @SoulType AS SoulType, @Reset AS CharReset,@PetCount AS PetCount,@ActPoint AS ActPoint,@DonationPoint AS DonationPoint

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

** Procedure 설명	:  캐릭터의 이름을 변경한다
** Argument설명	:  @Userindex 유저인덱스, @Charidx 캐릭터인덱스
** Return Type		:  Flag   ==>   	1 :  캐릭터 삭제 완료         0  :  캐릭터 삭제 실패
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2009-03-16
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE  PROC [dbo].[UPCharRename] @Userindex INT, @Charidx TINYINT,@ReCharname VARCHAR(20),@Code INT,@Plate TINYINT,@Posx SMALLINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@DATE DATETIME,@Grade TINYINT,@Exitem INT,@C INT,@U VARCHAR(36),@A INT
	SET @DATE = GETDATE()
	SET @Flag = 1

 	SELECT @Grade=Grade FROM dbo.ClanMember WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx 
	SELECT @Exitem=COUNT(Userindex) FROM dbo.Exitem WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
	IF @Grade = 1
	BEGIN
		SET @FLAG = 2
		SELECT @Flag AS Flag 
	END

	ELSE IF @Grade>1
	BEGIN
		SET @FLAG=3
		SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	END

	ELSE IF @Exitem > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag=4
		SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
	BEGIN TRAN
		UPDATE dbo.Charinfo
		SET Charname=@ReCharname
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SELECT @Flag
			RETURN
		END
	
		UPDATE dbo.CharPos
		SET Charname=@ReCharname
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SELECT @Flag
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @U=Uuid,@C=Code,@A=Amount
		FROM dbo.Item WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx
		IF ( @C<>@Code OR @@ROWCOUNT<>1 ) 
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SELECT @Flag
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM dbo.Item WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx
			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag
				RETURN
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.UseFunctional(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,Amount,Ramount)
				VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Code,@U,@A,0)
			END
		END

		DELETE FROM dbo.CharFriend WHERE Fuserindex=@Userindex AND Fcharidx=@Charidx

		INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.CharEvent(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Charname,State)
		VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@ReCharname,'Rename')

	COMMIT TRAN
	SET @FLAG = 1
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag 
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

		SELECT @Co=COUNT(Userindex)
		FROM dbo.Item WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Rdate<=GETDATE() 

		IF @Co > 0
		BEGIN		
			DECLARE @fCnt INT
			SET @fCnt = 1
			WHILE @fCnt <= @Co
			BEGIN
				EXEC dbo.UPRideItemdeleteDB  @Userindex,@Charidx
				SET @fCnt = @fCnt + 1
			END
		END
		SET @Flag =1
	END
/*
	IF @Userindex < 6706
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS ( SELECT Userindex FROM dbo.EventItemList WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx)
		BEGIN
			EXEC [dbo].[OpRideItemAdd]  @Userindex,@Charidx,258,1,0,0,1,2
		END
	END
*/
	IF @State = 2 
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Ip VARCHAR(15),@Return BIGINT,@Return1 BIGINT,@DATE DATETIME
		SET @Date=GETDATE()
		SELECT @MateUserindex=Ouserindex,@SoulMateState=State
		FROM dbo.SoulMate WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND State=1
	
		-- SoulMate 가 없을 경우 
		IF @SoulMateState IS NULL
			SET @Flag = 0
		-- SoulMate 가 비활성화 상태인 경우
		ELSE IF @SoulMateState = 0
			SET @Flag = 2
		-- SoulMate 가 있고 정상 상태인 경우 
		ELSE IF @SoulMateState = 1
		BEGIN
			EXEC @Return1=AsdaStoryOP.dbo.UpStartinfoUP  'id',@MateUserindex, 0, 0   -- MateUserindex의 State 를 0으로 변경
			EXEC @Ip=JoyLog1.dbo.UPLogOutUser @Seridx,@MateUserindex,@Return1,@DATE

			EXECUTE @RETURN=JoyLog1.dbo.UPLoginGame @Seridx,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Ip, @DATE ,2
			EXEC AsdaStoryOP.dbo.UpStartinfoUP 'id', @Userindex, 1,@RETURN

			SET @Flag =1
		END
	END
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE  PROC [dbo].[UPClanActPointDonation] @Clanidx SMALLINT,@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@DonationtPoint INT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON	
	DECLARE @Date DATETIME,@Flag TINYINT,@Fpoint INT,@Cname VARCHAR(17),@Totpoint INT
	SET @Date=GETDATE()

	BEGIN TRAN
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.Chairnfo
		SET DonationPoint=DonationPoint+@DonationtPoint
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SELECT @Flag AS FLAG
			RETURN
		END	

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.ClanData
			SET @Fpoint=TotActPoint=TotActPoint+@DonationtPoint,@Cname=Cname,@Userindex=CapUserindex,@Charidx=CapCharidx,@Totpoint=UseActPoint
			WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx

			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag AS FLAG
				RETURN
			END	

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=1
				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.ClanEvent(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Clanidx,UsePoint,FluPoint,TotPoint,State)
				VALUES(@DATE,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Clanidx,@DonationtPoint,@Fpoint,@Totpoint,'Active Point Donation')
				SELECT @Flag AS Flag
			END
		END
	END
	COMMIT TRAN

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE   PROC [dbo].[UPClanBreakUp] @Clanidx SMALLINT,@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Cname VARCHAR(16),@joincnt TINYINT

	SELECT @Cname=Cname,@Joincnt=Joincnt 
	FROM dbo.ClanData WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx

	IF @Joincnt>1
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 3
	END
	
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	BEGIN TRAN
		DELETE FROM dbo.ClanData WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
		IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag = 0
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM dbo.ClanMember WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx			
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag = 0
			END
	
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- 100716 CampClanData Delete
				DELETE FROM dbo.CampClanData WHERE ClanIndex=@Clanidx
				-- CampClanData Delete End

				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.ClanLog (Edate, Userindex,Charidx,Clanidx,Cname,Gm,State)
				VALUES ( GETDATE(), @Userindex, @Charidx, @Clanidx, @Cname, 0,  'Clan Break Up')
				SET @Flag =1
			END
		END
	COMMIT TRAN
	END 

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag--,@Clanidx AS Clanidx
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

** Procedure 설명	: 클랜 생성
** Argument설명	:  
** Return Type		:  
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2006-05-31
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE        PROC [dbo].[UPClanCreate] @Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Cname VARCHAR(17),@Ctype TINYINT,
@Captain VARCHAR(20),@MaxCnt TINYINT,@Authority1 INT,@Authority2 INT,@Authority3 INT,@Authority4 INT,
@MarkFlag TINYINT,@Markidx BIGINT ,@MarkColor BIGINT,@MarkBorder BIGINT,@MarkBdColor BIGINT,@MarkBgColor BIGINT,@Mapidx TINYINT,@GM INT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	DECLARE @Clanidx SMALLINT, @FLAG TINYINT,@Joincnt TINYINT,@State TINYINT,@maxgrade TINYINT,@Gu VARCHAR(36),@RGm INT,@DATE DATETIME
	DECLARE @Aidx1 SMALLINT,@Aname1 VARCHAR(17),@Amark1 SMALLINT,@Aidx2 SMALLINT,@Aname2 VARCHAR(17),@Amark2 SMALLINT,@Aidx3 SMALLINT,@Aname3 VARCHAR(17),@Amark3 SMALLINT
	DECLARE @widx SMALLINT,@wname VARCHAR(17),@wmark SMALLINT,@Clanname1 VARCHAR(17),@BadCount SMALLINT
	DECLARE @TotActPoint INT,@UseActPoint INT 

	SET @DATE = GETDATE()
	SET @Joincnt=1
	SET @Maxgrade = 0
	SET @State=0
	SET @Aidx1=-1
	SET @Aname1=''
	SET @Amark1=-1
	SET @Aidx2=-1
	SET @Aname2=''
	SET @Amark2=-1
	SET @Aidx3=-1
	SET @Aname3=''
	SET @Amark3=-1
	SET @widx=-1
	SET @wname=''
	SET @wmark=-1
	SET @TotActPoint=0
	SET @UseActPoint=0
 	
	SELECT @BadCount=COUNT(*) 
	FROM LewdWordList  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE CHARINDEX(LewdWord, @Cname) > 0
	
	-- LewdWord 리스트에 있는지를 검색해서 있으면 3 를 리턴한다.
	IF @BadCount > 0
	BEGIN
		-- clanname 리스트에 있는지를 검색해서 있으면 -4 를 리턴한다.
		SET @Clanidx = -4 		--- 사용이 제한된 단어로 만들어진 클랜명
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-- clanname 리스트에 없을 경우 기존에 존재하는 클랜이름인지를 체크한다.
		IF EXISTS ( SELECT Cname  FROM ClanData WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)  WHERE Cname = @Cname )
		BEGIN
			SET @Clanidx=-3
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			BEGIN TRAN

			SELECT TOP 1 @Clanidx=Clanidx 
			FROM dbo.Clanidx  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
			WHERE Clanidx NOT IN ( SELECT Clanidx FROM dbo.ClanData  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)  )

			IF @Clanidx IS NULL 
			BEGIN				
				SET @clanidx = -2		-- 더이상 클랜 인덱스를 생성할 수 없을때
			END

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO dbo.ClanData(Clanidx,Cname,Ctype,Captain,Capuserindex,CapCharidx,MaxCnt,Joincnt,Maxgrade,State,Lvl,
				TotActPoint,UseActPoint,Authority1,Authority2,Authority3,Authority4,MarkFlag,Markidx,MarkColor,MarkBorder,MarkBdColor,MarkBgColor,
				Mapidx,Aidx1,Aname1,Amark1,Aidx2,Aname2,Amark2,Aidx3,Aname3,Amark3,Waridx,Warname,Warmark)
				VALUES (@Clanidx,@Cname,@Ctype,@Captain,@Userindex,@Charidx,@maxcnt,1,0,0,1,0,0,@Authority1,@Authority2,@Authority3,@Authority4,
				@MarkFlag,@Markidx,@MarkColor,@MarkBorder,@MarkBdColor,@MarkBgColor,@Mapidx,-1,'',-1,-1,'',-1,-1,'',-1,-1,'',-1)

				IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				BEGIN
					-- 클랜 생성이 실패하였을 경우
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					SET @Clanidx = -1
					SELECT @Clanidx AS Clanidx,@Cname AS Cname,@Ctype AS Ctype,@Captain AS Captain,@Userindex AS Capuserindex,@Charidx AS CapCharidx,
					@MaxCnt AS MaxCnt,@Joincnt AS Joincnt,@MaxGrade AS MaxGrade,@State AS State,@TotActPoint AS TotActPoint,@UseActPoint AS UseActPoint,
					@Authority1 AS Authority1,@Authority2 AS Authority2,@Authority3 AS Authority3,@Authority4 AS Authority4,
					@MarkFlag AS MarkFlag,@Markidx AS Markidx,@MarkColor AS MarkColor,@MarkBorder AS MarkBorder,@MarkBdColor AS MarkBdColor,@MarkBgColor AS MarkBgColor,
					@Mapidx AS Mapidx,@Aidx1 AS Aidx1,@Aname1 AS Aname1,@Amark1 AS Amark1,
					@Aidx2 AS Aidx2,@Aname2 AS Aname2,@Amark2 AS Amark2,@Aidx3 AS Aidx3,@Aname3 AS Aname3,@Amark3 AS Amark3,
					@widx AS widx,@wname AS wname,@wmark AS wmark
					RETURN				
				END

				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO dbo.ClanMember(Clanidx,Cname,Userindex,Charidx,Charname,Grade,DonationPoint,Callname,Memo)
					VALUES (@Clanidx,@Cname,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Captain,1,0,'','')
	
					IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
					BEGIN
						-- 클랜 생성이 실패하였을 경우
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						SET @Clanidx = -1
						SELECT @Clanidx AS Clanidx,@Cname AS Cname,@Ctype AS Ctype,@Captain AS Captain,@Userindex AS Capuserindex,@Charidx AS CapCharidx,
						@MaxCnt AS MaxCnt,@Joincnt AS Joincnt,@MaxGrade AS MaxGrade,@State AS State,@TotActPoint AS TotActPoint,@UseActPoint AS UseActPoint,
						@Authority1 AS Authority1,@Authority2 AS Authority2,@Authority3 AS Authority3,@Authority4 AS Authority4,
						@MarkFlag AS MarkFlag,@Markidx AS Markidx,@MarkColor AS MarkColor,@MarkBorder AS MarkBorder,@MarkBdColor AS MarkBdColor,@MarkBgColor AS MarkBgColor,
						@Mapidx AS Mapidx,@Aidx1 AS Aidx1,@Aname1 AS Aname1,@Amark1 AS Amark1,
						@Aidx2 AS Aidx2,@Aname2 AS Aname2,@Amark2 AS Amark2,@Aidx3 AS Aidx3,@Aname3 AS Aname3,@Amark3 AS Amark3,
						@widx AS widx,@wname AS wname,@wmark AS wmark
						RETURN
					END

					ELSE
					BEGIN
						--클랜 생성이 제대로 수행되었다면 클랜 창설 비용을 뺀다
						UPDATE dbo.Item
						SET @Gu=UUid,@RGm=Amount=Amount-@Gm,Fdate=@date
						WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Code=20551
						IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @RGm <1
						BEGIN
							-- 클랜 생성이 실패하였을 경우
							ROLLBACK TRAN
							SET @Clanidx = -1
							SELECT @Clanidx AS Clanidx,@Cname AS Cname,@Ctype AS Ctype,@Captain AS Captain,@Userindex AS Capuserindex,@Charidx AS CapCharidx,
							@MaxCnt AS MaxCnt,@Joincnt AS Joincnt,@MaxGrade AS MaxGrade,@State AS State,@TotActPoint AS TotActPoint,@UseActPoint AS UseActPoint,
							@Authority1 AS Authority1,@Authority2 AS Authority2,@Authority3 AS Authority3,@Authority4 AS Authority4,
							@MarkFlag AS MarkFlag,@Markidx AS Markidx,@MarkColor AS MarkColor,@MarkBorder AS MarkBorder,@MarkBdColor AS MarkBdColor,@MarkBgColor AS MarkBgColor,
							@Mapidx AS Mapidx,@Aidx1 AS Aidx1,@Aname1 AS Aname1,@Amark1 AS Amark1,
							@Aidx2 AS Aidx2,@Aname2 AS Aname2,@Amark2 AS Amark2,@Aidx3 AS Aidx3,@Aname3 AS Aname3,@Amark3 AS Amark3,
							@widx AS widx,@wname AS wname,@wmark AS wmark
							RETURN
						END

						ELSE
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.MoneyUse  (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Serial, Amount, Ramount, St)
							SELECT  @DATE,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Gu,@RGm+@Gm,@RGm,'Cost for Clan-organizing'
							
							INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.ClanLog (Edate, Userindex,Charidx,Clanidx,Cname,Gm,State)
							SELECT  @DATE, @Userindex, @Charidx, @Clanidx, @Cname,@Gm, 'Clan-organizing' 
						END
					END
				END
			END
			COMMIT TRAN
		END
	END

	SELECT @Clanidx AS Clanidx,@Cname AS Cname,@Ctype AS Ctype,@Captain AS Captain,@Userindex AS Capuserindex,@Charidx AS CapCharidx,
	@MaxCnt AS MaxCnt,@Joincnt AS Joincnt,@MaxGrade AS MaxGrade,@State AS State,@TotActPoint AS TotActPoint,@UseActPoint AS UseActPoint,
	@Authority1 AS Authority1,@Authority2 AS Authority2,@Authority3 AS Authority3,@Authority4 AS Authority4,
	@MarkFlag AS MarkFlag,@Markidx AS Markidx,@MarkColor AS MarkColor,@MarkBorder AS MarkBorder,@MarkBdColor AS MarkBdColor,@MarkBgColor AS MarkBgColor,
	@Mapidx AS Mapidx,@Aidx1 AS Aidx1,@Aname1 AS Aname1,@Amark1 AS Amark1,
	@Aidx2 AS Aidx2,@Aname2 AS Aname2,@Amark2 AS Amark2,@Aidx3 AS Aidx3,@Aname3 AS Aname3,@Amark3 AS Amark3,
	@widx AS widx,@wname AS wname,@wmark AS wmark

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

** Procedure 설명	: 클랜 생성
** Argument설명	:  
** Return Type		:  0 : 실패, 
			1 : 성공, 
			2 : 클랜에 가입되어 있거나 대기자이다, 
			3 : 대기자가 max이다
			4 : 존재하지 않는 클랜이름
			5 : 기존에 아예 다른 클랜에 가입이나 대기 상태 
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2006-05-31
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE PROC [dbo].[UPClanEnter] @Cname VARCHAR(16),@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@CharNAme VARCHAR(20)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Clanidx1 SMALLINT,@Clanidx2 SMALLINT,@Grade TINYINT,@Clanname VARCHAR(16),@JoinCnt TINYINT,@MaxCnt TINYINT

	SELECT @Clanidx1=Clanidx,@JoinCnt=JoinCnt,@MaxCnt=MaxCnt
	FROM dbo.ClanData  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Cname=@Cname 	

	IF @Clanidx1 IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 4  -- 존재하지 않는 클랜이름
		SET @Clanidx1 = -1
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Clanidx2=Clanidx,@Clanname=Cname,@Grade=Grade
		FROM dbo.ClanMember WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Cname=@Cname

		IF @Clanidx2 IS NULL
		BEGIN
			-- 가입해도 된다.
			INSERT INTO dbo.ClanMember(Clanidx,Cname,Userindex,Charidx,Charname,Grade,DonationPoint,CallName,Memo)
			VALUES (@Clanidx1,@Cname,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Charname,10,0,'','')
					SET @Flag =1
		END	

		ELSE IF @Clanidx2=@Clanidx1 AND @Grade=10
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag =2 
		END

		ELSE IF @Clanidx2=@Clanidx1 AND @Grade< 10
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag =3
		END

		ELSE IF @JoinCnt=@MaxCnt
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag = 4
		END

		ELSE IF @Clanidx2<>@Clanidx1
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag =5
		END
	END

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@Clanidx1 AS Clanidx

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

/*▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣
** Procedure 설명	: 클랜장이 자기의 클랜으로 초대 할 경우
** Argument설명	:  
** Return Type		:  0 : 실패, 
			1 : 성공, 
			2 : 이미 자기의 클랜원이다
			4 : 클랜 초대 옵션이 꺼져 있는 상태
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2006-05-31
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE   PROC [dbo].[UPClanInvite] @Clanidx SMALLINT,@Cname VARCHAR(17),@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Charname VARCHAR(20)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Clanidx1 SMALLINT,@Clanidx2 SMALLINT,@GuildEnroll TINYINT,@Grade TINYINT

	SELECT @GuildEnroll=GuildEnroll
	FROM dbo.CharOption WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex

	IF @GuildEnroll = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 4
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Clanidx1=Clanidx,@Grade=Grade
		FROM dbo.ClanMember WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

		IF @Clanidx1 IS NULL
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO dbo.ClanMember (Clanidx,Cname,Userindex,Charidx,Charname,Grade,DonationPoint,Callname,Memo)
			VALUES (@Clanidx,@Cname,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Charname,5,0,'' ,'' )

			IF @@Rowcount = 0
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag = 0 
			END
		
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE dbo.ClanData 
				SET Joincnt=Joincnt+1
				WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx

				SET @Flag = 1 
			END
		END
		
		ELSE IF @Clanidx=@Clanidx1 AND @Grade=10
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=3 -- 이미 자기의 클랜에 가입 대기 상태이다
		END

		ELSE IF @Clanidx=@Clanidx1 AND @Grade< 10
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag = 2 -- 이미  자기의 클랜에 클랜원이다
		END

 		ELSE IF @Clanidx1> -1 AND @Clanidx<>@Clanidx1  
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag = 5 -- 이미 다른 클랜 클랜원이다
		END
	
	END

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@Clanidx AS Clanidx, @Cname AS CName
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

/*▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣
** Procedure 설명	: 클랜장이 클랜의 정보를 수정할때 
** Argument설명	:  
** Return Type		:  
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2006-06-02
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE      PROC [dbo].[UPClanMarkUpdate] @Clanidx SMALLINT,@MarkFlag TINYINT,@Markidx BIGINT,@MarkColor BIGINT,@MarkBorder BIGINT,@MarkBdColor BIGINT,@MarkBgColor BIGINT,
@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Code INT,@Plate TINYINT,@Posx SMALLINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@BeforeMarkFlag TINYINT,@Date DATETIME,@Cname VARCHAR(17)
	SET @Date=GETDATE()

	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Uuid VARCHAR(36),@Amount INT
		SELECT @Uuid=Uuid,@Amount=Amount
		FROM dbo.Item
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Code=@Code AND Plate=@plate AND Posx=@Posx

		IF @Amount IS NULL
		BEGIN	
			SET @Flag=0
			SELECT @Flag AS Flag
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
		BEGIN TRAN
			DELETE FROM dbo.Item
			WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx AND Code=@Code
			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag
				RETURN
			END
			-- 소비아이템이 남아 있는 것이 없고 인벤토리에서 삭제 되는 로직이 제대로 수행 되었을 경우
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE dbo.ClanData
				SET @Cname=Cname,MarkFlag=1,Markidx=@markidx,MarkColor=@MarkColor,MarkBorder=@MarkBorder,MarkBdColor=@MarkBdColor,MarkBgColor=@MarkBgColor
				WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
				IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
				BEGIN
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					SET @Flag = 0
					SELECT @Flag
					RETURN
				END

				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.UseFunctional (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,Amount,Ramount)
					SELECT @Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@code,@Uuid,@Amount,0

					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.ClanLog(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Clanidx,Cname,Gm,State)
					SELECT @Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Clanidx,@Cname,0,'Clan crest Create'
				END	
	
				SET @Flag = 1
				SELECT @Flag AS Flag
			END 
		COMMIT TRAN
		END
	END	

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

/*▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣

** Date			:  2006-06-02
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE     PROC [dbo].[UPClanMaxGrade] @Clanidx SMALLINT,@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Gm INT,@Maxcnt TINYINT,@Maxgrade TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@RGm INT,@Cname VARCHAR(17),@DATE DATETIME, @Gu VARCHAR(36)
	SET @DATE = GETDATE()

	BEGIN TRAN
	BEGIN

	UPDATE dbo.ClanData
	SET Maxcnt=@Maxcnt,Maxgrade=@Maxgrade
	WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
	IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
	BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag=0
			SELECT @Flag AS Flag
			RETURN
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.Item
		SET @Gu=Uuid,@RGm=Amount=Amount-@Gm,Fdate=@DATE
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Code=20551
		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @Rgm < 1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag=0
			SELECT @Flag AS Flag
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Cname=Cname
			FROM dbo.ClanData WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
			WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
 
			INSERT INTO  JoyLog1.dbo.MoneyUse (Edate, Userindex, Charidx, Serial, Amount, Ramount, St)
			SELECT @DATE, @Userindex, @Charidx, @Gu, @RGm+@Gm, @RGm,'Increase in clan members-needed fees'

			INSERT JoyLog1.dbo.ClanLog (Edate, Userindex,Charidx,Clanidx,Cname,Gm, State)
			SELECT @DATE, @Userindex, @Charidx, @Clanidx, @Cname,@Gm, 'Increase in clan members'
			SET @Flag=1
		END
	END

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	END
	COMMIT TRAN	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE  PROC [dbo].[UPClanmemberdelete]  @Clanname VARCHAR(17),  @Charname VARCHAR(20)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT

	DELETE FROM dbo.ClanMember
	WHERE Cname=@Clanname AND Charname=@charname

	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 0 
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN

		WHERE Cname=@Clanname

		SET @Flag =1
	END
	
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag 
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
UPClanMemberGradeUp:
/*▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣

** Argument설명	:  @Userindex 유저인덱스, @Charidx 캐릭터 인덱스
** Return Type		:  
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2006-05-30
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE PROC [dbo].[UPClanMemberGradeUp] @Clanidx SMALLINT,@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Grade TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON	
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Joincnt TINYINT,@SubCaptain TINYINT

	IF @Grade=2
	BEGIN
		SELECT @JoinCnt=JoinCnt
		FROM dbo.ClanData
		WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx

		SELECT @SubCaptain=COUNT(*)
		FROM dbo.ClanMember
		WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx AND Grade=2

		IF @JoinCnt>50 AND @SubCaptain>=4
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=2
		END

		ELSE IF @Joincnt<=50 AND @SubCaptain>=3
		BEGIN
 			SET @Flag=2
		END

		ELSE IF @JoinCnt<=40 AND @SubCaptain>=2
		BEGIN
 			SET @Flag=2
		END

		ELSE IF @JoinCnt<=30 AND @SubCaptain>=1
		BEGIN
 			SET @Flag=2
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.ClanMember
			SET Grade=@Grade
			WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx AND Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=1
			END
		END
		SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.ClanMember
		SET Grade=@Grade
		WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx AND Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=0
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=1
		END
		
		SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

	BEGIN
		SELECT idx, Charname,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),Edate,120), Notice

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[UPClanNoticeUp] @Clanidx SMALLINT,@Writer VARCHAR(20),@Notice VARCHAR(500)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Co TINYINT,@Date DATETIME
	SET @Date=GETDATE()

	SELECT @Co=Count(*) 
	FROM dbo.ClanNotice
	WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx

	IF @Co<5
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO dbo.ClanNotice(Clanidx,Charname,Edate,Notice)
		VALUES(@Clanidx,@Writer,@Date,@Notice)
		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=0
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=1
		END	
	END

	ELSE IF @Co=5
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM dbo.ClanNotice
		WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx AND Idx=( SELECT TOP 1 Idx
				FROM dbo.ClanNotice
				WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx	
				ORDER BY idx )

		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=0
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO dbo.ClanNotice(Clanidx,Charname,Edate,Notice)
			VALUES(@Clanidx,@Writer,@Date,@Notice)
			
			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=0
			END

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=1
			END	
		END	
	END

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

** Return Type		:  
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2006-05-30

** Changes		:

CREATE  PROC [dbo].[UPClanOwnerTransfer]  @Clanidx SMALLINT,@CapUserindex INT,@CapCharidx TINYINT,@NewCapUerindex INT,@NewCapCharidx TINYINT,@Charname VARCHAR(20)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON	
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT

	BEGIN TRAN
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.ClanData
		SET CapUserindex=@NewCapUerindex,CapCharidx=@NewCapCharidx,Captain=@Charname
		WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx
		
		IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag=0
			SELECT @Flag
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.ClanMember
			SET Grade=4
			WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx AND Userindex=@CapUserindex AND Charidx=@CapCharidx
			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag=0
				SELECT @Flag
				RETURN
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE dbo.ClanMember
				SET Grade=1
				WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx AND Userindex=@NewCapUerindex AND Charidx=@NewCapCharidx
				IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
				BEGIN
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					SET @Flag=0
					SELECT @Flag
					RETURN
				END
			END
		END
	END
	COMMIT TRAN

	SET @Flag=1
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE  PROC [dbo].[UPClanPurge] @Clanidx SMALLINT, @Userindex INT, @Charname VARCHAR(20)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT

	DELETE FROM dbo.ClanMember
	WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx AND Userindex=@Userindex AND Charname=@charname

	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 0 
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE dbo.ClanData 
		SET Joincnt=Joincnt - 1
		WHERE Clanidx=@Clanidx

		SET @Flag =1
	END
	
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag 
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[UPExchangeItem] @Groupidx TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON	

	DECLARE  @Add1 TINYINT, @Time BIGINT
	SET @Add1 = 0
	SET @Time = 0

	SELECT idx, @Add1 as Add1,State,Code,Durability,Upcount,AcuUpcnt,MaxUpcnt,UpDamage,Amount,
	Opidx1,OpValue1,Opidx2,OpValue2,Opidx3,OpValue3,Opidx4,OpValue4,Opidx5,OpValue5,Refine,
	CAST(YEAR(gaindate) AS SMALLINT),CAST(MONTH(gaindate) AS SMALLINT),CAST(DAY(gaindate) AS SMALLINT),
	Slot,ChangeType,Class,Sgrade,Sex,
	Vtype,Spos,Sprice,
	CAST ( ISNULL(DATEDIFF(SECOND,GETDATE(),Fdate),0) AS BIGINT) Stime,Charname,
	Cell1,Cell2,Cell3,Cell4, @Time AS Time1
	FROM dbo.Exitem WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Gidx = @Groupidx  --AND Fdate > GETDATE()
	ORDER BY idx

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

						SET @Flag=0

					END

					END
				END
			END

			UPDATE dbo.Item
			SET @Tgm8=Amount=Amount+@Sprice8,@Gu8=Uuid,Fdate=@Date
			WHERE Userindex=@Userindex8 AND Charidx=@Charidx8 AND Code=20551
			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @Tgm8 < 1
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag AS Flag
				RETURN
			END

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @Stime8=24
				BEGIN 
					SET @Com8=0
				END
				ELSE IF @Stime8=72
				BEGIN
					SET @Com8=ROUND(@Sprice8*0.03,0)
				END				
				ELSE IF @Stime8=120				
				BEGIN
					SET @Com8=ROUND(@Sprice8*0.05,0)
				END
				ELSE IF @Stime8=168				
				BEGIN
					SET @Com8=ROUND(@Sprice8*0.07,0)
				END
		
				BEGIN
					UPDATE dbo.Item
					SET @Rgm8=Amount=Amount-@Com8,Fdate=@Date
					WHERE Userindex=@Userindex8 AND Charidx=@Charidx8 AND Code=20551
					IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @Rgm8 < 1

						ROLLBACK TRAN
						SET @Flag = 0
						SELECT @Flag AS Flag
						RETURN
					END
	
					ELSE
					BEGIN

						INSERT JoyLog1.dbo.ItemEvent (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,Amount,Ramount,State)
						VALUES ( @DATE,@Userindex8,@Charidx8,20551,@Gu8,@Rgm8+@Com8,@Rgm8,'Commission at the Exchange')

						INSERT INTO dbo.SellItemAlarm(Edate, Buserindex, Bcharidx, Suserindex, Scharidx, Charname, Code, Sprice,Stime)
						VALUES(@DATE,@Userindex, @Charidx,@Userindex8,@Charidx8,@Charname8,@Code8,@Sprice8,@Stime8)
					END
				END
			END
		END
	
		BEGIN
			IF @Uidx1 < 0
				SET @Sprice1=0

			IF @Uidx2 < 0
				SET @Sprice2=0
	
			IF @Uidx3 < 0
				SET @Sprice3=0
	
			IF @Uidx4 < 0
				SET @Sprice4=0
	
			IF @Uidx5 < 0
				SET @Sprice5=0
	
			IF @Uidx6 < 0
				SET @Sprice6=0

			IF @Uidx7 < 0
				SET @Sprice7=0
		
			IF @Uidx8 < 0
				SET @Sprice8=0
	
			SET @Price=@Sprice1+@Sprice2+@Sprice3+@Sprice4+@Sprice5+@Sprice6+@Sprice7+@Sprice8
		
			Update dbo.Item
			SET @Gu=Uuid,@Tgm=Amount=Amount-@Price,Fdate=@date
			WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Code=20551
			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @Tgm<1
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag AS Flag
				RETURN
			END

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.MoneyExchangeBuy (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Serial,Amount,Ramount)
				VALUES (@DATE,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Gu,@Tgm+@Price,@Tgm) --,'Purchase Fee at the Exchange')
			END		
		END
	END
	COMMIT TRAN

	SET @Flag=1
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.UPFameRatingHolder
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT h.TitleId     AS TitleId,
           h.CharIdx     AS CharIdx,
           h.Granted     AS Granted,
           h.PrevCharIdx AS PrevCharIdx,
           h.CharId      AS CharId,
           h.PrevCharId  AS PrevCharId,
           h.Value       AS Value,
           h.PrevValue   AS PrevValue,

UPFameRatingRevokeList:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.UPFameRatingRevokeList
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.FameRatingRevoke WHERE Done = 0)
        SELECT TOP (50)
               r.Id                                     AS Id,
               r.TitleId                                AS TitleId,
               r.CharIdx                                AS CharIdx,
               CAST(ISNULL(s.IsOnline, 0) AS TINYINT)   AS IsOnline,
               r.CharId                                 AS CharId,
               CAST(ISNULL(s.UserNum, 0) AS INT)        AS UserNum,
               r.CharName                               AS CharName
        FROM dbo.FameRatingRevoke r
        LEFT JOIN dbo.FameRatingSource s
               ON s.CharId = r.CharId AND s.CharIdx = r.CharIdx
        WHERE r.Done = 0
        ORDER BY r.Id;
    ELSE
        SELECT CAST(0   AS BIGINT)    AS Id,
               CAST(0   AS TINYINT)   AS TitleId,
               CAST(0   AS TINYINT)   AS CharIdx,
               CAST(0   AS TINYINT)   AS IsOnline,
               CAST(0   AS INT)       AS CharId,
               CAST(0   AS INT)       AS UserNum,
               CAST(N'' AS CHAR(21)) AS CharName;
END

/*▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣
** Procedure 설명	: 친구 등록
** Argument설명	:  
** Return Type		:  
1 : 친구 추가 성공 
2 : 성공 (A유저에게 B 유저는 이미 등록되어 있음 ) 
3 : 성공 (B 유저에게 B 유저는 이미 등록되어 있음 ) 
4 : 실패 (A 유저의 친구리스트 등록인원수가 꽉참)
5 : 실패 (B 유저의 친구리스트 등록인원수가 꽉참)
6 : 실패 (A, B 유저의 친구리스트 등록인원수가 꽉참)
7 : A, B 유저모두 이미 등록되어 있음
0 : 실패
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2009-04-17
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  양쪽 모두 추가 되는 방식으로 변경
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE PROC [dbo].[UPFriendAdd]  @Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Fuserindex INT,@Fcharidx TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@A TINYINT,@B TINYINT,@aCo TINYINT,@bCo TINYINT,@Acharname VARCHAR(20),@Bcharname VARCHAR(20)

	IF EXISTS (SELECT Charname FROM dbo.CharFriend  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND FUserindex=@Fuserindex AND Fcharidx=@Fcharidx )
	BEGIN
		SET @A=2
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT Charname FROM dbo.CharFriend  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex=@FUserindex AND Charidx=@FCharidx AND FUserindex=@Userindex AND Fcharidx=@Charidx )
	BEGIN
		SET @B=3
	END

	IF @A=2 AND @B=3
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag=7
	END

	ELSE IF @A=2
	BEGIN
		SELECT @aCo=COUNT(*) 
		FROM dbo.CharFriend  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Fuserindex AND Charidx=@Fcharidx
			
		IF @aCo=50
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag =5
		END
		
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Acharname=Charname 
			FROM dbo.Charpos  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
			WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
			
			INSERT INTO dbo.CharFriend (Userindex, Charidx, Fuserindex, FCharidx,Charname)
			VALUES (@FUserindex,@FCharidx,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Acharname)
			
			IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=2
			END
		END
	END

	ELSE IF @B=3
	BEGIN
		SELECT @bCo=COUNT(*)
		FROM dbo.CharFriend  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
		IF @bCo=50
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag =4
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Bcharname=Charname 
			FROM dbo.Charpos  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
			WHERE Userindex=@Fuserindex AND Charidx=@Fcharidx
	
			INSERT INTO dbo.CharFriend (Userindex, Charidx, Fuserindex, FCharidx,Charname)
			VALUES (@Userindex,@Charidx,@Fuserindex,@Fcharidx,@Bcharname)
		
			IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=3
			END
		END
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @aCo=COUNT(*)
		FROM dbo.CharFriend  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

		SELECT @bCo=COUNT(*)
		FROM dbo.CharFriend  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Fuserindex AND Charidx=@Fcharidx

		IF @aCo=50 AND @bCo=50
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=6
		END	

		ELSE IF @aCo=50 AND @bCo<50
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=4
		END

		ELSE IF @aCo<50 AND @bCo=50
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=5
		END
			
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Bcharname=Charname 
			FROM dbo.Charpos  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
			WHERE Userindex=@Fuserindex AND Charidx=@Fcharidx

			INSERT INTO dbo.CharFriend (Userindex, Charidx, Fuserindex, FCharidx,Charname)
			VALUES (@Userindex,@Charidx,@Fuserindex,@Fcharidx,@Bcharname)
	
			IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag =0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Acharname=Charname 
				FROM dbo.Charpos  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
				WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
		
				INSERT INTO dbo.CharFriend (Userindex, Charidx, Fuserindex, FCharidx,Charname)
				VALUES (@FUserindex,@FCharidx,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Acharname)
		
				IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
				BEGIN
					SET @Flag=0
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @Flag=1
				END
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

** Procedure 설명 : 게임 내에서 Gm이 유저에게 아이템을 지급할 경우 
** Argument설명	 :  @Seridx   서버 인덱스    @Userindex     유저의 인덱스   @Charidx   캐릭터 인덱스   @PortalID   마을의 인덱스
**				@Code1		구입하는 1번째 아이템의 코드
**				@Plate1			구입하는 1번째 아이템의 플레이트
**				@Posx1			구입하는 1번째 아이템의 X 좌표
**				@Amount1		구입하는 1번째 아이템의 구입 개수
**				@Weight1		구입하는 1번째 아이템의 무게
**				@Gm1			구입하는 1번째 아이템의 구입 가격
** Return Type	 : Flag   ==> 1 : 성공   0 : 실패  		
** 수정 사항
** Date		       : 2006-10-10
** Programmer	: 나승은
** Changes		: 
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE     PROC [dbo].[UPGmItemAdd] @Userindex1 INT,@Charidx1 TINYINT,@Userindex2 INT,@Charidx2 TINYINT,
@Code INT,@Plate TINYINT,@Posx SMALLINT,@Amount INT,@Durability TINYINT,@Weight SMALLINT,@Cell1 INT,@Cell2 INT,@Cell3 INT,@Cell4 INT,
@upcount TINYINT,@MaxUpCnt TINYINT,@AcuUpCnt TINYINT,@UpDamage SMALLINT,
@Opidx1 SMALLINT,@OpValue1 SMALLINT,@Opidx2 SMALLINT,@OpValue2 SMALLINT,
@Opidx3 SMALLINT,@OpValue3 SMALLINT,@Opidx4 SMALLINT,@OpValue4 SMALLINT,@Opidx5 SMALLINT,@OpValue5 SMALLINT,@Refine TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	DECLARE @Uuid VARCHAR(36),@Flag TINYINT,@Code1 INT,@Ra INT,@Charname1 VARCHAR(20),@Charname2 VARCHAR(20),@DATE DATETIME
	DECLARE @U1 VARCHAR(36),@U2 VARCHAR(36),@U3 VARCHAR(36),@U4 VARCHAR(36)	 
	SET @Date = GETDATE()
	SELECT @Charname1=Charname FROM dbo.Charinfo WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex1 AND CHaridx = @Charidx1 
	SELECT @Charname2=Charname FROM dbo.Charinfo WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Userindex = @Userindex2 AND Charidx = @Charidx2

	BEGIN TRAN
	-- GM 지급하는 아이템이 외형 & 기능성 아이템일 경우
	IF @Plate=1
	BEGIN
		SET @uuid =NEWID()		

				IF @Cell1 >0
				BEGIN
					SET @U1=NEWID()
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @U1=NULL
				END

				IF @Cell2 >0
				BEGIN
					SET @U2=NEWID()
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @U2=NULL
				END

				IF @Cell3 >0
				BEGIN
					SET @U3=NEWID()
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @U3=NULL
				END

				IF @Cell4 >0
				BEGIN
					SET @U4=NEWID()
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @U4=NULL
				END

		INSERT dbo.item (Userindex,Charidx,Uuid,Code,Plate,Posx,Amount,Durability,Weight,Uc1,Cell1,Uc2,Cell2,Uc3,Cell3,Uc4,Cell4,Upcount,AcuUpCnt,MaxUpcnt,Updamage,Opidx1,OpValue1,Opidx2,OpValue2,Opidx3,OpValue3,Opidx4,OpValue4,Opidx5,OpValue5,Refine,Owner,GainDate)
		VALUES (@Userindex2,@Charidx2,@uuid,@Code,@Plate,@Posx,@Amount,@Durability,@Weight,@U1,@Cell1,@U2,@Cell2,@U3,@Cell3,@U4,@Cell4,@Upcount,@AcuUpcnt,@MaxUpCnt,@updamage,@Opidx1,@OpValue1,@Opidx2,@OpValue2,@Opidx3,@OpValue3,@Opidx4,@OpValue4,@Opidx5,@OpValue5,@Refine,0,@Date)

		IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SELECT @Flag
			RETURN
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.AdminItemLog (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Fromname,Suserindex,Scharidx,Toname,Code,Serial,Amount,Durability,Cell1,Cell2,Cell3,Cell4,Upcount,Opidx1,OpValue1,OPidx2,OpValue2,State)
			VALUES(@Date,@Userindex1,@Charidx1,@Charname1,@Userindex2,@Charidx2,@Charname2,@Code,@Uuid,@Amount,@Durability,@Cell1,@Cell2,@Cell3,@Cell4,@Upcount,@Opidx1,@OpValue1,@Opidx2,@OpValue2, 'Item Add(Gm Command)')
		END
	END

	-- GM 이 지급하는 아이템이 소비성 아이템 일경우	
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Code1=Code FROM dbo.Item WHERE Userindex=@Userindex2 AND Charidx=@Charidx2 AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx 
		-- 기존에 존재하는 아이템의 코드와 주려고 하는 아이템의 코드가 다를 경우
		IF @Code1 <> @Code
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SELECT @Flag
			RETURN
		END
		
		IF @Code1 IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SET @uuid =NEWID()		
			INSERT dbo.item (Userindex,Charidx,Uuid,Code,Plate,Posx,Amount,Durability,Weight,Uc1,Cell1,Uc2,Cell2,Uc3,Cell3,Uc4,Cell4,Upcount,AcuUpCnt,MaxUpcnt,Updamage,Opidx1,OpValue1,Opidx2,OpValue2,Opidx3,OpValue3,Opidx4,OpValue4,Opidx5,OpValue5,Refine,Owner,GainDate)
			VALUES (@Userindex2,@Charidx2,@uuid,@Code,@Plate,@Posx,@Amount,@Durability,@Weight,NULL,0,NULL,0,NULL,0,NULL,0,@Upcount,@AcuUpcnt,@MaxUpCnt,@updamage,@Opidx1,@OpValue1,@Opidx2,@OpValue2,@Opidx3,@OpValue3,@Opidx4,@OpValue4,@Opidx5,@OpValue5,@Refine,0,@Date)

			IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag
				RETURN
			END

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.AdminItemLog (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Fromname,Suserindex,Scharidx,Toname,Code,Serial,Amount,Durability,Upcount,Opidx1,OpValue1,OPidx2,OpValue2,State)
				VALUES(@Date,@Userindex1,@Charidx1,@Charname1,@Userindex2,@Charidx2,@Charname2,@Code,@Uuid,0,@Amount,@Upcount,@Opidx1,@OpValue1,@Opidx2,@OpValue2, 'Item Add(Gm Command)')
			END
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.Item
			SET @Ra=Amount=Amount+@Amount, Weight=@Weight, @Uuid=UUid
			WHERE Userindex=@Userindex2 AND Charidx=@Charidx2 AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx
		
			IF @@ROWCOUNT=0
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag
				RETURN
			END
		
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.AdminItemLog (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Fromname,Suserindex,Scharidx,Toname,Code,Serial,Amount,Durability,Upcount,Opidx1,OpValue1,OPidx2,OpValue2,State)
				VALUES(@Date,@Userindex1,@Charidx1,@Charname1,@Userindex2,@Charidx2,@Charname2,@Code,@Uuid,@Ra-@Amount,@Ra,@Upcount,@Opidx1,@OpValue1,@Opidx2,@OpValue2, 'Item Add(Gm Command)')
			END
		END
	END

	COMMIT TRAN
	
	SET @Flag = 1
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag

	SET  XACT_ABORT OFF
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE PROC [dbo].[UPGotChaCashItemBuy] @Orderidx INT,@Seridx TINYINT,@Channel TINYINT,@Poridx TINYINT,@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,
	@Code INT,@Plate TINYINT,@Posx SMALLINT,@Amount INT,@Durability TINYINT, @Weight SMALLINT,
	@Cell1 INT,@Cell2 INT,@Cell3 INT,@Cell4 INT,@upcount TINYINT,@MaxupCnt TINYINT,@AcuUpcnt TINYINT,@Updamage SMALLINT,
	@OPidx1 SMALLINT,@OpValue1 SMALLINT,@OpIdx2 SMALLINT,@OpValue2 SMALLINT,@OPidx3 SMALLINT,@OpValue3 SMALLINT,@OpIdx4 SMALLINT,@OpValue4 SMALLINT,@OpIdx5 SMALLINT,@OpValue5 SMALLINT,@Owner TINYINT,@gm INT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON 

	DECLARE @Uc1 VARCHAR(36),@Uc2 VARCHAR(36),@Uc3 VARCHAR(36),@Uc4 VARCHAR(36),@Uuid VARCHAR(36)
	DECLARE @Return TINYINT,@Uid VARCHAR(61),@Charname VARCHAR(20),@Flag TINYINT,@DATE DATETIME

	SET @Date=GETDATE()
	SET @Uuid = NEWID()
	SELECT @Uid=Uid,@Charname=Charname
	FROM dbo.CharPos WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx

	SET @Uc1 = CASE  WHEN @Cell1 >0 THEN NEWID() ELSE NULL END
	SET @Uc2 = CASE  WHEN @Cell2 >0 THEN NEWID() ELSE NULL END
	SET @Uc3 = CASE  WHEN @Cell3 >0 THEN NEWID() ELSE NULL END
	SET @Uc4 = CASE  WHEN @Cell4 >0 THEN NEWID() ELSE NULL END

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[Item] ( [Userindex], [Charidx], [Uuid], [Code], [Plate], [Posx], [Amount], [Durability], [Weight], [Uc1], [Cell1], [Uc2], [Cell2], [Uc3], [Cell3], [Uc4], [Cell4], [Upcount], [AcuUpcnt], [MaxupCnt], [Updamage], [Opidx1], [OpValue1], [Opidx2], [OpValue2], [Opidx3], [OpValue3], [Opidx4], [OpValue4], [OPidx5], [OpValue5], [Refine], [Owner],[Fdate])
    SELECT @Userindex, @Charidx, @Uuid, @Code, @Plate, @Posx, @Amount, @Durability, @Weight, @Uc1, @Cell1, @Uc2, @Cell2, @Uc3, @Cell3, @Uc4, @Cell4, @Upcount, @AcuUpcnt, @MaxupCnt, @Updamage, @Opidx1, @OpValue1, @Opidx2, @OpValue2, @Opidx3, @Opvalue3, @Opidx4, @Opvalue4, @OPidx5, @Opvalue5, 0, @Owner, @Date
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 0
		SELECT @Flag
	END
	
	-- INSERT 되는 아이템 구입이 제대로 이루어 졌을 경우
	ELSE
	BEGIN
 		IF @Code < 7001
		BEGIN
			INSERT JoyLog1.dbo.BuyGachaFunctional(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Channel,Poridx,Code,Serial,Ramount)
			VALUES (@DATE,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Channel,@Poridx,@Code,@uuid,@Amount)

			INSERT AsdaStoryOP.dbo.GachaFunctionalPayment (Seridx,Gameid,Userindex,Charidx,Charname,Edate,Channel,Poridx,Orderidx,Uuid,Code,Ramount,Umac)
			VALUES (@seridx+1,@Uid,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Charname,@DATE,@Channel,@Poridx,@Orderidx,@Uuid,@Code,@Amount,@Gm)
		END 

		ELSE IF @Code > 7000
		BEGIN
			INSERT JoyLog1.dbo.BuyGachaPremium(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Channel,Poridx,Code,Serial,Upcount,AcuUPcnt,MaxUPcnt,Updamage,Opidx1,Opvalue1,Opidx2,Opvalue2,Opidx3,Opvalue3,Opidx4,Opvalue4,Opidx5,Opvalue5)
			VALUES (@DATE,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Channel,@Poridx,@Code,@uuid,@upcount,@AcuUpcnt,@maxUpcnt,@Updamage,@OPidx1,@OpValue1,@Opidx2,@OpValue2,@Opidx3,@OpValue3,@Opidx4,@OpValue4,@Opidx5,@OpValue5)

			INSERT AsdaStoryOP.dbo.GachaPayment (Seridx,Gameid,Userindex,Charidx,Charname,Edate,Channel,Poridx,Orderidx,Uuid,Code,Umac)
			VALUES (@seridx+1,@Uid,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Charname,@DATE,@Channel,@Poridx,@Orderidx,@Uuid,@Code,@Gm)
		END

		SET @Flag=1
		SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	END

CREATE  PROC [dbo].[UPHairChange] @Orderidx INT,@Seridx TINYINT,@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Hairidx SMALLINT,@HairStyle TINYINT,@HairColor TINYINT,@Mac INT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Charname VARCHAR(20),@Hs TINYINT,@Hc TINYINT,@DATE DATETIME,@Uid VARCHAR(20)
 	SET @DATE=GETDATE()
	SET @Seridx=1

	SELECT @Uid=Uid,@Charname=Charname
	FROM dbo.CharPos WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx 

	UPDATE dbo.CharAppr
	SET @Hs=HairStyle,@Hc=HairColor,HairStyle=@HairStyle, HairColor=@HairColor
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx 
	IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1
	BEGIN	
		SET @Flag = 0
		SELECT @Flag AS Flag
		RETURN
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN

		VALUES (@DATE,@seridx,@Uid,@charname,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Orderidx,@Hairidx-1000,@Mac)

		INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.HairChange (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Bstyle,Bcolor, Mac, Hairidx,Astyle,Acolor )
		VALUES (@DATE, @Userindex, @Charidx, @Hs,@Hc, @mac, @Hairidx-1000,@HairStyle,@HairColor ) 
	END
 
	SET @Flag=1
	SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	RETURN	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
UPItemChange:
/*▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣
** Procedure 설명 : 	아이템 교환  ( 유저들간의 교환 ) - 5개의 아이템 까지 교환가능,Gm 교환도 가능함
**				    	아이템 구입(Insert) 이 실패했을 경우는 Gm 값 변화없다
**					아이템 구입이 성공했을 경우 WORLDLOG DB에 아이템 구입에 대한 이벤트로그를 남긴다

**					@delPlate1 : A의 1번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delPosx1 : A의 1번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delPlate2 : A의 2번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delPosx2 : A의 2번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delPlate3 : A의 3번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delPosx3 : A의 3번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delPlate4 : A의 4번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delPosx4 : A의 4번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delPlate5 : A의 5번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delPosx5 : A의 5번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delOtherPlate1 : B의 1번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delOtherPosx1 : B의 1번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delOtherPlate2 : B의 2번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delOtherPosx2 : B의 2번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delOtherPlate3 : B의 3번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delOtherPosx3 : B의 3번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delOtherPlate4 : B의 4번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delOtherPosx4 : B의 4번째 교환 아이템 Posx
**					@delOtherPlate5 : B의 5번째 교환 아이템 Plate         @delOtherPosx5 : B의 5번째 교환 아이템 Posx

**					@Plate1				A 유저가 교환으로 얻게 되는 1번째 아이템 Plate
**					@Posx1				A 유저가 교환으로 얻게 되는 1번째 아이템 Posx
**					@Amount1			A 유저가 교환으로 얻게 되는 1번째 아이템 개수
**					@Durability1			A 유저가 교환으로 얻게 되는 1번째 아이템 내구도
**					@Weight1			A 유저가 교환으로 얻게 되는 1번째 아이템 무게
**					@OtherCode1 		B 유저가 교환으로 얻게 되는 1번째 아이템 코드		B 가 교환으로 받을 수 잇는 아이템이 5가지 존재
**					@OtherPlate1		B 유저가 교환으로 얻게 되는 1번째 아이템 Plate

/*▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣
** Procedure 설명	:  게임에서 제대로 세이브 못하고 로그아웃 할때
** Argument설명	:  @ID VARCHAR(20)
** Return Type		:  Flag   ==> 	1 :  로그아웃 성공         0  :  로그아웃 실패
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2005-08-8
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  주석수정
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE     PROC  [dbo].[UPLogOutCharacter] @Seridx TINYINT, @Userindex  INT, @Charidx TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Portalidx BIGINT,@Loginidx BIGINT,@DATE DATETIME
	SET @Flag = 1
	SET @DATE = GETDATE()

	UPDATE dbo.CharPos
	SET  UserNum=-1, Partyidx=-1, Captain=0, SoulState = 0, State=0
	WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx = @Charidx

	UPDATE AsdaStoryop.dbo.Us_member 
	SET UserNum=-1,Flag=0,@Loginidx=Loginidx,@Portalidx=Portalidx
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex

	EXEC JoyLog1.dbo.UPPortalLogout @Seridx,@Userindex,@Charidx,0,@DATE,@Portalidx
	EXEC JoyLog1.dbo.UPLogOut @Seridx, @Userindex, @Charidx, @DATE,@Loginidx

	SELECT @Flag   AS Flag  -- 1 : success, 0 : failure

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE PROC [dbo].[UPMoveBlock] @ServerGroupidx TINYINT, @Charname VARCHAR(20), @Period TINYINT
AS
	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Uid VARCHAR(61),@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@Usernum SMALLINT,@Channel TINYINT,@Poridx TINYINT
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT @Uid=Uid,@Userindex=Userindex,@Charidx=Charidx, @Usernum=Usernum, @Channel=Channel, @Poridx=Poridx
	FROM dbo.Charpos WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Charname = @Charname 

	IF @Usernum = -1 
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 0
		DELETE FROM dbo.BlockCharacter WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx = @Charidx 
		INSERT INTO BlockCharacter (Uid, Userindex, Charidx, Charname, Type1, State, BlockDate, EndDate )
		VALUES ( @Uid, @Userindex, @Charidx, @Charname, 2, @Flag, GETDATE(), DATEADD(MINUTE, @Period, GETDATE()) )
	END

	ELSE IF @Usernum IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 2
		SET @Userindex = 0
		SET @Charidx = 0
		SET @Usernum = -1
		SET @Channel  = 0
		SET @Poridx = 0		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag = 1	
		DELETE FROM dbo.BlockCharacter WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx = @Charidx 
		INSERT INTO BlockCharacter (Uid, Userindex, Charidx, Charname, Type1, State, BlockDate, EndDate )
		VALUES ( @Uid, @Userindex, @Charidx, @Charname, 2, @Flag, GETDATE(), DATEADD(MINUTE, @Period, GETDATE() ) )
	END

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@Userindex AS Userindex,@Charidx AS Charidx,@Usernum AS Usernum,@Channel AS Channel,@Poridx AS Poridx

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

/*====================================================================================================================
** Procedure Desc	:  아바타의 닉네임을 생성할때 사용 가능한지를 체크한다.  캐릭터생성할때 Flag 값을 반환하여 준다
** Argument Desc	:  @CharName varchar(20)
** Return Type		:  Flag   ==>   1  :  닉네임으로 사용가능
**				        2  :  중복 닉네임이 존재하기 때문에 사용 불가능   
**				        3  :  Lewd Word 이기 때문에 사용불가능
** Modify Desc
** Date			:  2003-09-25
** Programmer		:  Na Seung Eun
** Changes		:   
**====================================================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROC  [dbo].[UPNickCheck] @CharName VARCHAR(20) 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT, @BadCount TINYINT

	SELECT @BadCount=COUNT(LewdWord) FROM LewdWordList WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE CHARINDEX(LewdWord, @Charname) > 0
	
	-- LewdWord 리스트에 있는지를 검색해서 있으면 3 를 리턴한다.
		IF @BadCount > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag =3 		--- 사용이 제한된 단어로 만들어진 닉네임
		SELECT @Flag
	END
	
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-- LewdWord 리스트에 없을 경우 기존에 존재하는 닉네임인지를 체크한다.
		IF EXISTS ( SELECT Charname  FROM dbo.CharPos WITH (READUNCOMMITTED) WHERE Charname = @charname )
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag=2
			SELECT @Flag		-- 중복 닉네임이 존재한다.
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag = 1
			SELECT @Flag 		-- 입력받은 닉네임으로 사용 가능하다.
		END
	END

	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[UPPetHatch] @Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@State TINYINT,
@Code INT,@Plate TINYINT,@Posx SMALLINT,@DCode INT,@Dplate TINYINT,@Dposx SMALLINT,
@BCode INT,@Bplate TINYINT,@Bposx SMALLINT,@Petindex SMALLINT,@PetName VARCHAR(16),@PetMaxLvl TINYINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	DECLARE @Charname VARCHAR(20),@Pu VARCHAR(36),@Su VARCHAR(36),@Flag TINYINT,@DATE DATETIME,@PetUnique INT
	SET @DATE=GETDATE()

	SELECT @Charname=Charname
	FROM dbo.CharPos
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx
	
	BEGIN TRAN
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Pu=UUid
		FROM dbo.Item WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx AND Code=@Code
		
		IF @Pu IS NULL
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SET @PetUnique=-1
			SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@PetUnique AS PetUnique
			RETURN
		END
		
		DELETE FROM dbo.Item
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx AND Code=@Code

		IF @@ERROR<>0 OR @@ROWCOUNT<>1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			SET @Flag = 0
			SET @PetUnique=-1
			SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@PetUnique AS PetUnique
			RETURN
		END
		
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Dcode>0
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Su=UUid
				FROM dbo.Item
				WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@DPlate AND Posx=@DPosx AND Code=@Dcode
		
				DELETE FROM dbo.Item
				WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@DPlate AND Posx=@DPosx AND Code=@Dcode

				IF @@ERROR<>0 OR @@ROWCOUNT<>1
				BEGIN
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					SET @Flag = 0
					SET @PetUnique=-1
					SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@PetUnique AS PetUnique
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PremiumUse (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,Amount,Ramount,State,Fromname)
					VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Dcode,@Su,0,0,'Pet Hatch Success-Use',@Charname)
				END
			END

			IF @Bcode>0
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @Bu VARCHAR(36)
				SELECT @Bu=UUid
				FROM dbo.Item
				WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@BPlate AND Posx=@BPosx AND Code=@Bcode
		
				DELETE FROM dbo.Item
				WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@BPlate AND Posx=@BPosx AND Code=@Bcode

				IF @@ERROR<>0 OR @@ROWCOUNT<>1
				BEGIN
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					SET @Flag = 0
					SET @PetUnique=-1
					SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@PetUnique AS PetUnique
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PremiumUse (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,Amount,Ramount,State,Fromname)
					VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Bcode,@Bu,0,0,'Pet Hatch Success-Use',@Charname)
				END
			END

			IF @State=1
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO dbo.CharPetList (Userindex,Charidx,Petindex,PetName,FullNess,PetLvl,PetMaxLvl,PetExp,Active)
				VALUES(@Userindex,@Charidx,@Petindex,@PetName,100,1,@PetMaxLvl,0,0)
				SET @PetUnique=@@IDENTITY
	
				IF @@ERROR<>0 OR @@ROWCOUNT<>1
				BEGIN
					ROLLBACK TRAN	
					SET @Flag = 0
					SET @PetUnique=-1
					SELECT @Flag AS Flag,@PetUnique AS PetUnique
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PetEvent(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Petindex,PetUnique,PetName,PetMaxLvl,State)
					VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Petindex,@PetUnique,@PetName,@PetMaxLvl,'Pet Hatch-Create')

					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PetHatch (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,State)
					VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@code,@Pu,'Pet Hatch Success-Use')
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @PetUnique=-1

				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PetEvent(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Petindex,PetUnique,PetName,PetMaxLvl,State)
				VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Petindex,@PetUnique,@PetName,@PetMaxLvl,'Pet Hatch-Fail')


				INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PetHatch (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,State)
				VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@code,@Pu,'Pet Hatch Fail-Use')
			END
		END
	END
	COMMIT TRAN

	SET @Flag = 1
	SELECT @Flag as Flag,@PetUnique AS PetUnique

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF

iState : 1(대성공, 최대레벨+1, 경험치+50%), 2(성공, 최대레벨+1), 3(실패),  4(대실패, 현제레벨-1)
** Argument설명	:  
** Return Type		:  
** 수정 사항
** Date			:  2009-04-29
** Programmer		:  나승은
** Changes		:  
**▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣▣*/
CREATE  PROC [dbo].[UPPetLevelLimitless] @Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@State TINYINT,@PetUnique INT,@Clvl TINYINT,@MaxLvl TINYINT,@Exp INT,@Code INT,@Plate TINYINT,@Posx SMALLINT
			,@Protcode INT,@ProtPlate TINYINT,@ProtPosx SMALLINT,@Weight SMALLINT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT,@Date DATETIME,@Petindex SMALLINT,@PetName VARCHAR(16)
	SET @Date=GETDATE()

	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Uuid VARCHAR(36),@Amount INT
		DECLARE @ProtUuid VARCHAR(36),@RProtAmount INT, @LastProtItemCnt INT

		--To DO - reduce once query.
		SELECT @Uuid=Uuid,@Amount=Amount
		FROM dbo.Item
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Code=@Code AND Plate=@plate AND Posx=@Posx
		
		IF @ProtCode > -1
		BEGIN
		SELECT @ProtUuid=Uuid,@RprotAmount = Amount
		FROM dbo.Item
		WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Code=@ProtCode AND Plate=@Protplate AND Posx=@ProtPosx
		END
	
		IF @Amount IS NULL
		BEGIN	
			SET @Flag=0
			SELECT @Flag AS Flag
		END

		ELSE
		BEGIN
		BEGIN TRAN
			DELETE FROM dbo.Item
			WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@Plate AND Posx=@Posx AND Code=@Code
			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				SET @Flag = 0
				SELECT @Flag
				RETURN
			END
			-- 소비아이템이 남아 있는 것이 없고 인벤토리에서 삭제 되는 로직이 제대로 수행 되었을 경우
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE dbo.CharPetList
				SET PetLvl=@cLvl,PetMaxLvl=@MaxLvl,PetExp=@Exp,@Petindex=Petindex,@Petname=PetName
				WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND PetUnique=@PetUnique

				IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
				BEGIN
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					SET @Flag = 0
					SELECT @Flag
					RETURN
				END

				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.UsePetFunctionalNostack (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial )
					VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@code,@Uuid)

					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PetEvent(Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Petindex,PetUnique,PetName,State)
					VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@Petindex,@PetUnique,@Petname,'Max Level')
					
				END		
			END
	
			---Delete used protect item by Shin 09.07.20
			IF @ProtCode > -1
			BEGIN
				IF @RprotAmount = 1
				BEGIN
				DELETE FROM dbo.Item
				WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@ProtPlate AND Posx=@ProtPosx AND Code=@ProtCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
					BEGIN
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						SET @Flag = 0
						SELECT @Flag
						RETURN
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE dbo.Item SET @LastProtItemCnt = Amount = Amount - 1, [Weight] = @Weight
					WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND Plate=@ProtPlate AND Posx=@ProtPosx AND Code=@ProtCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 OR @@ERROR<>0
					BEGIN
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						SET @Flag = 0
						SELECT @Flag
						RETURN
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
					---Add : Log Used Premium Item For PetLevelLimitless
					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.UsePetFunctional (Edate, Userindex, Charidx, Code, Serial, Amount, Ramount)
					SELECT @Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@code,@ProtUuid,1,@LastProtItemCnt
			
					INSERT INTO JoyLog1.dbo.PremiumUse (Edate,Userindex,Charidx,Code,Serial,Amount,Ramount,[State])
					VALUES(@Date,@Userindex,@Charidx,@code,@ProtUuid,1,@LastProtItemCnt,'Pet PremiumItem Use')
					END
				END
			END
			SET @Flag = 1
			SELECT @Flag AS Flag
		COMMIT TRAN
		END
	END	
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE   PROC [dbo].[UPPetRename]  @Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@PetUnique INT,@PetName VARCHAR(16)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	DECLARE @Flag TINYINT ,@NameFlag TINYINT ,@BadCount TINYINT
 
	SELECT @NameFlag=NameFlag
	FROM dbo.CharPetList
	WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND PetUnique=@PetUnique

	IF @NameFlag=0
	BEGIN
		SET @Flag=3
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @BadCount=COUNT(LewdWord) FROM LewdWordList WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
		WHERE CHARINDEX(LewdWord, @PetName) > 0
	
		-- LewdWord 리스트에 있는지를 검색해서 있으면 3 를 리턴한다.
		IF @BadCount > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @Flag =2 		--- 사용이 제한된 단어로 만들어진 닉네임
		END
	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.CharPetList
			SET PetName=@PetName,NameFlag=0
			WHERE Userindex=@Userindex AND Charidx=@Charidx AND PetUnique=@PetUnique

			IF @@ROWCOUNT<>1 
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=0	
			END

			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Flag=1
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT @Flag AS Flag
	SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE         PROC [dbo].[UPPrivateChat]  @Charname VARCHAR(20)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON	
	DECLARE @State TINYINT,@Threadidx TINYINT,@Gsidx TINYINT,@Poridx TINYINT,@Channel TINYINT,@Userindex INT,@Charidx TINYINT,@UserNum SMALLINT,@Whisper TINYINT, @Campidx SMALLINT--, @SoulState TINYINT
	
	SELECT @Userindex=Userindex,@Charidx=Charidx,@UserNum=UserNum,@Gsidx=Gsidx,@Threadidx=Threadidx,@Channel=Channel,@Poridx=CPoridx,@State=State--, @SoulState = SoulState
	FROM dbo.CharPos  WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
	WHERE Charname = @Charname

	IF @Userindex IS NULL 
	BEGIN
		SET @State = 3
		SET @Userindex = -1
		SET @Charidx = 10
		SET @UserNum = -1
		SET @Poridx = 0
		SET @Threadidx=0
		SET @Channel = 0
		SET @Gsidx=0
		SET @Whisper = 0
		SET @Campidx = -1
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN		
		IF @UserNum = -1
		BEGIN
			SET @State = 0
			SET @Userindex = -1
			SET @Charidx = 10
			SET @UserNum = -1
			SET @Poridx = 0
			SET @Threadidx=0
			SET @Channel = 0
			SET @Gsidx=0
			SET @Whisper = 0
			SET @Campidx = -1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Whisper = Whisper
			FROM dbo.CharOption 
			WHERE Userindex = @Userindex 

			SET @State= 1

			IF @Whisper = 0 
			BEGIN
				SET @State = 2 
			END

			-- 100128 황태윤 추가
			IF @Poridx = 19
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Campidx = Campidx
				FROM dbo.CharCamp 
				WHERE Userindex = @Userindex AND Charidx = @Charidx
				
				IF @Campidx IS NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @Campidx = -1
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Campidx = -1
			END			
			--
		END
	END

	SELECT @State AS State,@Userindex AS Userindex,@Charidx AS Charidx,@UserNum AS UserNum,@Poridx AS Poridx,@Threadidx AS Threadidx,@Channel  AS Channel ,@Gsidx AS Gsidx,@Whisper AS Whisper, @Campidx AS Campidx--, @SoulState AS SoulState

	SET NOCOUNT OFF
